metric_units.fa: raw fraction; paper table displays fa * 1e4

notes: Only a complete canonical 24-file test split receives paper deltas; validation is reported separately.
IoU and ACC/SegAcc use global foreground counts, not sequence-averaged metrics. ACC here means foreground recall, not overall binary accuracy.
Pd/Fa use the EV-SpSegNet reference: integer milliseconds, open 50ms intervals, object recovery fraction >= 0.0001, one 8-connected-component count per frame, and uint8 false-pixel counts.
The pinned PACT utils/eval.py increments false_num inside the per-false-event loop. This analyzer uses the EV-UAV benchmark definition instead; PACT legacy-code Fa is not directly comparable.
PointEvent public tester reports global foreground IoU/ACC and mean per-sequence AUC. Pd/Fa are independently recomputed here under the shared EV-UAV benchmark definition.
Original checkpoints, seed 1024 and threshold 0.9 are retained. No validation or test threshold search is performed. Counts at 0.5 are diagnostics only.

Native Windows torch-reference backend differs from fused official CUDA extensions; numerical agreement with paper values alone does not establish operator equivalence or matching retraining protocols.
